name: Nous-Hermes-2-Mixtral-8x7B-DPO
notes: MoE record: params_b 46.70 is the safetensors total, active_params_b 12.9 is Mixtral's published activated-parameter figure for this architecture (2 of 8 experts per token plus attention, router and embeddings), NOT a value read from config.json - config.json only states num_local_experts 8 and num_experts_per_tok 2. Do not conflate the two: all 46.70B of weights must be resident, while per-token compute is ~12.9B. fine-tuned from mistralai/Mixtral-8x7B-v0.1 via OpenHermes-2.5 then DPO; _name_or_path names NousResearch/OpenHermes-2.5-Mixtral-8x7B-epoch4. hidden 4096, 32 layers, 32 query heads / 8 KV heads, rope_theta 1000000, 32768 native context, vocab 32002. head_dim derived as 4096 / 32 = 128; gqa_ratio = 4. KV bytes/token at bf16 (2 bytes/element): 32 layers x 8 KV heads x 128 head_dim x 2 (K and V) x 2 bytes = 131072 B/token = 128.0 KiB/token. KV is per-token modest (1.75 GiB at its native 32k context), but 46.7B weights at bf16 (93.4 GB) is the binding constraint - a 2x80GB SXM minimum before any KV at all. context_scaling is null: context length is native to the pretrained config, no rope_scaling.
